name: Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)
description: Monthly food assistance loaded onto a debit-style card, usable at most grocery stores and farmers markets.
income_threshold: Varies by household size and income; some non-citizens may still qualify
other_eligibility_notes: Eligibility interview can be done by phone; can apply together with Cash Assistance and Medicaid
required_documents: Photo ID;Proof of income;Proof of residence

name: Cash Assistance
description: Monthly cash help for families in need, often paid via debit card or directly to a landlord for rent.
income_threshold: Based on income, resources, and household size
other_eligibility_notes: Work/training program participation generally required unless age 60+
required_documents: Photo ID;Proof of residence;Proof of income

name: Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC)
description: Federal, state, and city tax credit for working individuals and families with low to moderate income; averages about $2,300 combined.
income_threshold: Single without children: up to ~$19,104/yr; married with children: up to ~$68,675/yr
other_eligibility_notes: Must have a valid Social Security number; must file a tax return
required_documents: W-2s or income records;Social Security number

name: Child Tax Credit (CTC)
description: Federal and NY State tax credit for families raising children, worth up to ~$3,200 per child under four and ~$2,700 for ages 4-16.
income_threshold: Up to $200,000/yr (single) or $400,000/yr (married filing jointly)
other_eligibility_notes: Only one parent can claim a shared child; must file a tax return
required_documents: Social Security numbers for filer and dependents

name: Head Start / Early Head Start
organization: U.S. Dept. of Health & Human Services
description: Free early childhood education, meals, and health screenings for low-income families with children age 5 and under.
income_threshold: At or below federal poverty guidelines (e.g. ~$33,000/yr for household of 4)
other_eligibility_notes: Also open to families in temporary housing or already receiving Cash Assistance/SNAP/SSI
required_documents: Proof of income or public benefits receipt;Child's age verification

name: Disability Rent Increase Exemption (DRIE)
description: Freezes rent for tenants with a qualifying disability benefit; landlord receives a tax credit for the difference.
income_threshold: Household income $50,000/yr or less; rent must exceed one-third of monthly income
other_eligibility_notes: Must live in rent-stabilized, rent-controlled, or similarly regulated housing; must receive SSI, SSDI, VA disability, or disability Medicaid
required_documents: Government ID;Proof of residence and lease;Proof of income;Disability benefit award letter

name: Senior Citizen Rent Increase Exemption (SCRIE)
description: Freezes rent for seniors 62+ so they keep paying their current rent even if the landlord raises it.
income_threshold: Household income $50,000/yr or less; rent must exceed one-third of monthly income
other_eligibility_notes: Must be 62+; must live in rent-stabilized, rent-controlled, or similarly regulated housing
required_documents: Proof of age and identity;Proof of rent/lease;Proof of household income

name: Section 8 / Housing Choice Voucher
description: Voucher that covers part of rent for lower-income families renting from a private landlord; tenant pays no more than ~40% of income toward rent.
income_threshold: Household of 1: ~$59,400/yr; household of 4: ~$84,800/yr
other_eligibility_notes: Applications are currently closed as of this data pull -- check status before referring a client
required_documents: N/A while applications closed

name: Qualified Health Plans (QHP)
description: Subsidized private health insurance marketplace plans covering preventive care and pre-existing conditions at no extra cost.
income_threshold: Subsidy amount depends on income; those below certain thresholds may qualify for Medicaid/Essential Plan/CHP instead
other_eligibility_notes: Must be a NY State resident and a U.S. citizen or lawfully present
required_documents: Proof of NY State residency;Immigration/citizenship status documentation

name: Comprehensive After School System (COMPASS NYC)
organization: NYC Dept. of Youth & Community Development
description: Free afterschool programs for K-12 students offering homework help, STEM, arts, and sports, typically 3 hours/day.
income_threshold: No income requirement
other_eligibility_notes: Open to all NYC students in kindergarten through 12th grade; individual program sites may add requirements
required_documents: Proof of child's identity (birth certificate, passport, or school record)

name: Pre-K for All
description: Free full-day, play-based Pre-K program for four-year-olds at public schools, DOE-run centers, and partner organizations.
income_threshold: No income requirement
other_eligibility_notes: Child must have been born in the qualifying year (rolling by school year); toilet training not required
required_documents: Child's proof of age/birth record

name: School Tax Relief Program (STAR)
organization: NYS Dept. of Taxation / NYC DOF
description: Annual credit that lowers property taxes for eligible homeowners; Enhanced STAR gives a larger benefit to qualifying seniors.
income_threshold: Basic STAR: household income $500,000/yr or less; Enhanced STAR (65+): ~$110,750/yr or less for 2026
other_eligibility_notes: Must own and live in the home as a primary residence; register once to receive it automatically each year
required_documents: Social Security numbers of all owners;Prior tax return;School district name

name: Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
description: Free comprehensive health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization across empanelled hospitals.
income_threshold: Family income below ₹2,50,000/yr or listed under SECC / BPL / Antyodaya
other_eligibility_notes: Covers cashless treatment, pre-existing conditions from day one, surgeries, and medicines
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;Ration Card or Family ID;BPL Certificate

name: NFSA / PDS Food Ration (Ration Card)
description: Monthly subsidized or free food grains (rice, wheat, coarse grains) providing nutrition security to vulnerable households.
income_threshold: Annual household income under ₹1,50,000 (Priority Households) or ₹1,00,000 (Antyodaya AAY)
other_eligibility_notes: Under One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC), migrant workers can collect ration from any Fair Price Shop across India
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;Ration Card;Proof of residence;Income certificate

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi
description: Direct income benefit of ₹6,000 per year transferred into bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000.
income_threshold: All small and marginal landholding farmer families with cultivable land
other_eligibility_notes: Institutional landholders, income tax payers, and constitutional post holders are excluded; e-KYC required
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;Land records (Khata / Khasra);Bank account passbook

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Interest subsidy and direct financial grant up to ₹2,67,000 to construct or purchase pucca house for low-income and homeless families.
income_threshold: EWS income up to ₹3,00,000/yr; LIG income up to ₹6,00,000/yr; rural poor families
other_eligibility_notes: Applicant household must not own a pucca permanent house anywhere in India; female head of household co-ownership prioritized
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;Income Certificate;Affidavit of no pucca house;Bank passbook

name: MGNREGA Rural Employment Guarantee
description: Statutory guarantee of at least 100 days of paid wage employment per financial year to adult members willing to do manual work.
income_threshold: Open to all adult members of rural households seeking wage employment
other_eligibility_notes: Equal wages for men and women; unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days
required_documents: MGNREGA Job Card;Aadhaar Card;Bank or Post Office passbook

name: Indira Gandhi National Social Assistance (NSAP)
description: Monthly pension assistance for destitute senior citizens (IGNOAPS 60+), widows (IGNWPS), and persons with severe disabilities (IGNDPS).
income_threshold: Below Poverty Line (BPL) cardholders; seniors aged 60+ or persons with 40%+ certified disability
other_eligibility_notes: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into pensioner's bank or postal savings account
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;BPL Card;Disability Certificate (UDID) if applicable;Age verification document;Bank passbook

name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit
description: Collateral-free working capital micro-loan of ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 with 7% interest subsidy for urban street vendors and hawkers.
income_threshold: Urban street vendors engaged in vending on or before the scheme cutoff date
other_eligibility_notes: No collateral needed; early repayment rewarded with higher credit limit and monthly digital cashback
required_documents: Aadhaar Card;Vendor ID Card or Letter of Recommendation from Urban Local Body (ULB);Bank passbook

name: Universal Credit
organization: UK Department for Work and Pensions (DWP)
description: Comprehensive monthly payment to help with living and housing costs for people on low income or out of work across the UK.
income_threshold: Household savings and capital must be under £16,000; income below allowance threshold
other_eligibility_notes: Replaces six legacy benefits including Housing Benefit, Child Tax Credit, and Income Support; must be 18+
required_documents: National Insurance number;Bank details;Tenancy agreement / proof of rent;Proof of income

name: Canada Child Benefit (CCB)
description: Tax-free monthly benefit to help eligible Canadian families with the cost of raising children under 18 years of age.
income_threshold: Maximum benefit of up to $7,787 per child under 6 and $6,570 per child aged 6-17; phases out with higher family income
other_eligibility_notes: Must live with a child under 18 and be primarily responsible for their care; must file annual Canadian tax return
required_documents: Social Insurance Number (SIN);Child birth certificate;Proof of Canadian residency
